Raw answers of real TallyPrime 7.1 (tally-versions mode tdsch, run 38155837948, 11-Oct-2026; bridge ref bd80c0cbe, the published 2.4.2; test company FinCom Spike Co, test data only): obj-*.xml.gz, FinComVoucherObject exactly as 2.4.2 builds it for a TDS deduction typed on the screen (K1), deductions made by XML (X1, X6), the TDS payment made on Tally's Stat Payment screen (SP1, before and after the Challan Reconciliation keys) and a TDS payment made by XML with its challan details (PX1); ledlist-raw.xml.gz, FinComLedgers as 2.4.2 builds it; ledger-lists-candidates.xml.gz, a Ledger collection with the lower-deduction lists; natures.xml.gz, a TDSRate collection (the natures of payment with their thresholds and rates).
